transcript.text: Hi everyone, before I finalize and sign off on Aria Vale's remote appearance package for the festival's closing stream, I need to check in with both of you. We've got a live 20-minute segment planned on the worldwide stream. Could the broadcast engineer and rights manager each let me know if there are any production requirements or clearance issues I need to build into the final specs? I want to make sure we've covered everything before I send the package to production.

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a critical production issue. My post-rehearsal network test showed that the venue cannot maintain reliable two-way latency for a live performance. However, it can reliably play an artist-approved file — but that file must be exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. I completed this test after the last production meeting and haven't entered the result in the production log yet. This directly conflicts with the currently planned live 20-minute segment, so we'll need to adjust the package before you send final specs to production.
